bagPolicy.summary: The Sovereign has no specific bag policy, but all bags are searched at entry.
bagPolicy.quote: All bags will be subject to search upon entry.

parking.summary: There's plenty of street parking around the venue in the Grand Center Arts District. Street parking security isn't guaranteed.
parking.quote: At the Grand Center Arts District there is abundant street parking around the venue.

rideshare.summary: The Sovereign strongly encourages rideshare, since security on street parking can't be guaranteed. Set your pickup to 3306 Washington Blvd.
rideshare.quote: we strongly encourage ride share since we cannot guarantee security on street parking.

concessions.summary: Outside drinks aren't allowed in the building. Drinks are pay as you go with no tabs, and all major credit cards and cash are accepted. The venue is smoke-free, but guests over 21 can smoke in the art park next door.
concessions.quote: No outside drinks allowed in the building (it's the law!)

accessibility.summary: If a condition, injury or disability needs special consideration, call the office Monday through Friday 1pm to 5pm at 314-588-0505, or email info@sovereignstl.com.
accessibility.quote: Contact us in the office Monday through Friday 1pm – 5pm at 314-588-0505

reEntry.summary: You can step outside through the double doors, but close them behind you and come back in through the front of the building.
reEntry.quote: close the doors behind you and re-enter the building in the front

ticketPickup.summary: The box office sells tickets with no fees on any concert night, and tickets are also sold exclusively through Etix. Avoid third-party resellers. Children 3 and under don't need a ticket, and age limits vary by show.
ticketPickup.quote: Children ages 3 and under DO NOT need a ticket.

gates.summary: Doors usually open an hour before the show, but times change, so check your event page. Enter at the front of the building.
